record.oneLiner: A sturdy small ornithischian of the very end of the Cretaceous.
record.description: Thescelosaurus was a small, heavily built ornithischian herbivore of Late Cretaceous western North America, 3–4 m long, with a long low snout ending in a beak and a stiffened tail. It was among the last non-avian dinosaurs.

notableFacts.text: One of the last non-avian dinosaurs before the extinction.
Its long tail was stiffened by rod-like ossified tendons.
